reading_source: All supplied page 1 readings reviewed in meat context. Explicit 羊肉 ようにく, 馬肉 ばにく, 鹿肉 しかにく, 猪肉 いのししにく. Preserve long vowels in ぎゅうにく/ようにく. Katakana words converted to hiragana for speech, Japanese pronunciation retained. Exact dictionary targets only, others provisional. Page 2: all 32 supplied readings checked in meat context, including けん, ぎゅうすじ, けつごうそしき, こつずい, かたろーす, てばさき/てばもと/てばなか, すなぎも and あいびきにく. ヒレ means tenderloin, not fish fin; its accent remains provisional. Lexical は in はつ retained. Long vowels retained in protein/collagen/loin/liver terms. Exact dictionary targets where sense appropriate; otherwise provisional. Page 3: all supplied readings reviewed in meat context: うすぎりにく, こまぎれにく, きりおとし, かたまりにく, ほねつきにく, かわつき, あかみ, あぶらみ, しもふり, すじ, にくじゅう. Preserve long vowel in にくじゅう/とくちょう; no particle conversions needed. Existing corrected あぶらみ recording preserved; あかみ and すじ reused from page 2. Exact dictionary matches where available, others provisional. Page 4: all supplied meat preparation readings reviewed: すじきり, したあじをつける, つけこむ, にくをたたく, やきいろをつける, にこむ, ねかせる, よねつ, ちゅうしんおんど, なまやけ, くさみをとる. Object を spoken お in action phrases, keys unchanged. Each phrase connected, no pauses before particles; heading pause only between categories. 寝かせる culinary resting context. Exact dictionary targets retained, unavailable phrase targets provisional. Page 5: every supplied dish reading reviewed: やきにく, やきとり, すきやき, しゃぶしゃぶ, とんかつ, かくに, ちゃーしゅー, はんばーぐ, そぼろ, つくね. Preserve long vowels, lexical は in はんばーぐ, connected repeated しゃぶしゃぶ. All names Japanese culinary pronunciation, compact connected delivery. Dictionary targets where available, others provisional. Page 6: every supplied descriptive phrase reviewed in meat context, including うまみがつよい, あぶらのあまみ, あぶらっこい, にくにくしい, じゅーしー, しっとりしている, すじっぽい, こうばしい, けものくさい, くさみがある and くせがある. Preserve gemination and long vowels, lexical kana and attached particles. Short phrases continuous; heading pauses only between categories. Exact dictionary matches where available, whole-phrase targets otherwise provisional.
notes: All six requested meat pages reviewed; no listening verification claimed.
